scale.0: No usable evidence, absent, or materially fails the stated criterion.
scale.1: Very limited evidence; major gaps or unsupported claims.
scale.2: Partial achievement; noticeable gaps, uneven execution, or weak evidence.
scale.3: Meets the brief well; evidence supports the criterion with only minor gaps.
scale.4: Exceptional, specific and well-supported achievement of the criterion.

1.title: Why are we here?
1.source: pfad/assignments/01-why-are-we-here.md (How it is marked); teaching slides deck/week02.py (Assignment 1 marking guidance) and deck/week03.py (marking handoff).

criteria.name: Argument
criteria.description: A position of the student's own, clearly stated, argued and supported; a defended claim is stronger than a survey.

criteria.name: Specificity
criteria.description: Concrete detail, named references and meaningful connection to the student's own practice; generic futurism is weak.

criteria.name: Craft
criteria.description: Essay is structured, edited, within 500-1000 words, uses Markdown appropriately, and citations/links are credible and relevant.

criteria.name: Process
criteria.description: PROCESS.md honestly describes AI use, one kept output and one rejected output with reasons; commit history shows work across multiple days.

2.title: Data visualisation
2.source: pfad/assignments/02-data-visualisation.md (How it is marked); teaching slides deck/week03.py (Assignment 2 brief/rubric) and deck/week04.py (submission/check guidance).

criteria.name: Data
criteria.description: A natural phenomenon is represented using real published data; source is linked and documented; raw reply is cached in data/ and the repo works offline.

criteria.name: Picture
criteria.description: The visual communicates or expresses something; transformation fits the data. Informative and artistic approaches are equally valid. The work is made from actual numbers.

criteria.name: Code
criteria.description: Scripts read committed data, run with uv run and declared dependencies, and contain a readable loop and a student-written function.

criteria.name: Process
criteria.description: PROCESS.md honestly describes AI use, one kept output and one rejected output with reasons; commit history shows development across multiple days.
